title: Select
summary: The browser select in the same skin as the text input. Its options are its own option and optgroup children; a phone shows its native picker.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value; what the form submits. A form reset sets it back to its initial value without raising the commit event, as a native control does: pk-form raises pk-reset after it, so a host that mirrors the value reads it again there. A browser state restore also sets it silently.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name (aria-label). pk-field fills it from its own label when this is empty.

props.name: description
props.description: Help and error text, exposed as aria-description; pk-field fills it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction; also set by a disabled fieldset.

props.name: required
props.description: The form cannot be submitted while the value is empty.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Shows the invalid state and sets aria-invalid; set by pk-field or pk-form (or by a Blazor EditContext).

props.name: warning
props.description: Shows the warning state (a value the user may want to check).

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allows several selections (value is comma-separated with a comma inside an option value written as a backslash and a comma, a backslash before a comma or backslash doubled; the form submits one entry each).

props.name: options
props.description: Options as data: a flat array of { value, label, disabled? }, a plain array of strings, or grouped as [{ group, options: [...] }]. Rendered straight into the inner select (the host's own option/optgroup children are never touched, only read). When set (non-empty), it wins over slotted option/optgroup children and a warning is logged once.

slots.description: option and optgroup elements; ignored while options is set.

events.name: input
events.description: The value changed (native, composed: bubbles out of the shadow root). Read event.target.value.

events.name: change
events.description: The user committed the value (re-dispatched from the inner control, composed).

events.name: pk-value-change
events.description: The user committed a new value (same moment as change; carries the value).

a11y: A native select in the shadow root: keyboard, type-to-select and the platform picker are the browser's own. Named by label, described by description.

examples.title: Options from data
examples.description: The options property builds the option/optgroup elements from data (flat, or grouped) instead of slotted option children; also settable as a JSON attribute.
